practices.summary: MREC is the default global-table mode: asynchronous replication, last-writer-wins conflict resolution, strong reads only within a region.
MRSC gives strongly consistent cross-region reads via synchronous replication; transaction operations are unsupported and the mode is immutable.
MREC transactions are atomic only in the invoking region and are not replicated as a unit.
Multi-region writes need an explicit region-routing story; implicit routing makes conflict domains invisible.
